title: 第26章苦门之后第27章魂晶归体
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
韩铁衣的尸体倒在地上，胸口的石种碎成粉末。
风一吹，粉末扬起来，飘向青石矿方向。
苏意低头看着自己右臂。
那道红色的魂晶痕迹从手腕延伸到肩膀，血管壁里的暗红色纹路随着心跳一明一暗。
赵铁骨的手还按在他腕上，指尖在抖。
“魂晶入体。”
赵铁骨重复了一遍，声音压得很低，“千万矿奴的怨念凝成的魂晶，入体后会在经脉里生根。
你刚才把魂晶按进伤口，不是把它当武器用——是让它和你的血融在一起。
国术种子的运转把它吞进去了，现在它在你的经脉里循环，和气血一起走。
这比石魈蛊花更险——蛊花是外来的，能拔；魂晶是你自己的血和千万人的怨念烧在一起凝出来的，拔不掉。”
他松开手，转头看了一眼赵独锋。
“你师父鲁大山的师门——六合门——就是研究魂晶入体走火入魔死的。
六合门当年发现魂晶能提升修士的感知力，开始尝试用魂晶入体练照心镜。
结果魂晶里的残魂怨念太重，练到第三层的人全都走火入魔，疯了。”
苏意看着自己右臂上的红痕。
红痕没有消失，也没有继续扩散，只是安安静静地留在皮肤底下，像一道还没结疤的伤口。
他试着握拳，右臂的骨裂处在铁骨晶修复下已经不疼了，但拳头握紧的时候，能感觉到一股不属于自己的力量在血管里涌动。
不是灵力，是苦。
千万矿奴的苦。
“走火入魔的先放一边。”

苏意抬头看向天上那八只仙鹤。
韩铁衣死了，剩下的鹤骑弟子全愣在半空。
有人的弩弓还指着地面，手指扣在扳机上忘了放；有人拽着鹤颈的羽毛，仙鹤被妖气惊得盘旋不定。
他们看见了全程——筑基七层的执事被一个没有灵力的矿奴一拳打穿了石甲。
这个画面超出了所有人的认知。
“还打吗？”
苏意问。
八只仙鹤同时拔高，往青云宗方向飞。
没有人回答，但弩弓全收了。
仙鹤翅膀扇动的声音越来越远，最后消失在云层里。
苏意转身往回走。
一千两百人的队伍停在山谷里，锅碗瓢盆堆在路边，抱着孩子的女人蹲在石头后面，牵着老人的年轻人站在原地一动不动。
他们全看见了——不是看见韩铁衣怎么死，是看见苏意怎么打。
何老闷把弯柄铁锤拄在地上，张着嘴忘了合。
content_en:
Han Tieyi's body fell to the ground, and the stone in his chest was shattered into powder.
When the wind blows, the powder rises and floats towards the bluestone mine.
Su Yi looked down at his right arm.
The red soul crystal trace extended from the wrist to the shoulder, and the dark red lines in the blood vessel walls flickered with the heartbeat.
Zhao Tiegu's hand was still on his wrist, his fingertips trembling.
"The soul crystal enters the body."
Zhao Tiegu repeated it in a very low voice, "The soul crystal condensed from the resentment of thousands of mine slaves will take root in the meridians after entering the body.
When you pressed the soul crystal into the wound just now, you were not using it as a weapon - you were letting it blend with your blood.
The circulation of the seeds of the martial arts swallowed it up, and now it circulates in your meridians, traveling with the qi and blood.
This is more dangerous than the stone mandrill poison flower - the poison flower is from outside and can be pulled out; the soul crystal is formed by burning your own blood and the resentment of millions of people and cannot be pulled out. "
He let go of his hand and turned to look at Zhao Dufeng.
“Your master Lu Dashan’s sect—Liuhe Sect—is studying how soul crystals can enter the body and lead to fire, demons, and death.
The Liuhe Sect discovered that soul crystals could improve monks' perception, and began to try to use soul crystals to enter the body to practice the mind mirror.
As a result, the resentment of the remaining souls in the soul crystal was too strong, and those who reached the third level of training became possessed and went crazy. "
Su Yi looked at the red mark on his right arm.
The red mark did not disappear, nor did it continue to spread. It just stayed quietly under the skin, like a wound that had not yet formed a scar.
He tried to clench his fist. The fractured bone in his right arm was no longer painful after being repaired by the iron bone crystal. But when he clenched his fist, he could feel a force that did not belong to him surging in his blood vessels.
It’s not spiritual power, it’s suffering.
The suffering of millions of mining slaves.
"Put aside those who are obsessed with it."
Su Yi raised his head and looked at the eight cranes in the sky.
Han Tieyi died, and the remaining Heqi disciples were all stunned in mid-air.
Some people's crossbows were pointed at the ground, their fingers on the triggers and they forgot to release them; some people pulled the feathers on the crane's neck, and the crane was frightened by the evil spirit and hovered uncertainly.
They saw the whole process - the deacon on the seventh floor of the foundation was punched through the stone armor by a mine slave who had no spiritual power.
This picture is beyond everyone's understanding.
"Still fighting?"
Su Yi asked.
Eight cranes rose up at the same time and flew towards the Qingyun Sect.
No one answered, but the crossbows were all drawn.
The sound of the crane's wings flapping became farther and farther away, and finally disappeared into the clouds.
Su Yi turned around and walked back.
The team of 1,200 people stopped in the valley, pots and pans were piled on the roadside, the woman holding the child squatted behind the rocks, and the young man holding the old man stood motionless.
They all saw it - not how Han Tieyi died, but how Su Yi beat him.
He Laomeng leaned on the ground with his bent-handled hammer, opening his mouth and forgetting to close it.
